notes.b0_relationship: B0 (local[2], shuffle.partitions=200, default.parallelism unset, AQE off) is included as the reference condition and is not one of the 12 candidates. Its medians are also the T_ref calibration source named in PLAN sections 15/33.
notes.exp001_not_run: PLAN day 22 schedules EXP-001 (20-run noise profile, median CV <= 10%) before EXP-002. EXP-001 has NOT been executed. EXP-002 therefore estimates run-to-run noise internally from its own within-configuration repetitions (n=2 per cell, pooled across the 13 configurations of a panel). This is a documented deviation and a stated limitation, not a substitute for EXP-001.
notes.no_selection: EXP-002 establishes sensitivity only. It does not select a configuration, does not tune anything, and does not touch the VALIDATION or TEST splits.
notes.repetition_rationale: PLAN section 33 fixes EXP-002 at 192 runs over the 12-config grid, which decomposes uniquely as 12 x 4 families x 2 scales x 2 repetitions. The plan does not state whether the factor 2 is repetitions or seeds. This spec reads it as 2 measured repetitions at one TRAIN seed: holding the dataset instance fixed isolates the configuration effect, which is exactly what the RQ0 sensitivity question asks. Cross-seed robustness is a separate question and is not claimed by EXP-002.
notes.timeout_rationale: PLAN section 11 timeout = 5x default-config median cannot be applied before the reference medians exist at every cell, and deriving it from this study's own early observations would make the stopping rule outcome-dependent. Fixed per-scale ceilings are therefore declared in advance. The measured B0 small medians (Day 17: 1.9-16.7 s) sit far below the 300 s small ceiling.
